mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the load was the most worthwhile action because it connected the assembled sensory and motor pathways to an observable adjustment. The picture description and brief explanation made the sequence understandable without assuming a detailed pathway.

leastWorthwhile.text: Putting the cup in the arm was a predictable setup step. It was clear, though it contributed less to my understanding on its own.

surprise.text: The spindle picture’s comparison of shorter and stretched lengths showed signals becoming more closely spaced as the muscle stretches. That made the sensory role more concrete.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary. The named motor connection slot made that fitting explicit, and the cup and load followed the stated goal.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the final adjustment made me curious about how other body systems will support the working arm. The account depends on picture descriptions, so I cannot judge how clearly finished illustrations would communicate the ideas.
